about_the_game:
This demo showcases the first-day loop and core systems of Order Up!.
Highlights

  • Dynamic queue & cashier flow

  • Tray assembly, delivery, and seating

  • Complaint/anger, tips, and reputation

  • Short, guided tutorials

What’s Inside

  • Around 20–30 minutes of gameplay

  • Limited recipe set and seating

  • End-of-day summary (speed/quality/tips)

Full Version Plans

  • Expanded recipes & appliances

  • Progression, upgrades, more days & scenarios

  • Enhanced audio/visual polish

Controls

  • Keyboard & mouse (experimental gamepad). Playable on Steam Deck; pick “Medium/High” for balanced performance.

Enjoy! If you like it, please add to your wishlist. 💚
